more.title: GGUF LLM Models with Hidden Malware on Hugging Face Reached 2400 Victims
more.excerpt: A scan of all 3273389 public Hugging Face model repositories found five malicious models downloaded 2428 times. The main campaign, Mir2k, hides a Windows remote access trojan at the end of GGUF files and later arms the chat template to make the model print the command that unpacks it.
